title: 📌 Your Matchup, Front and Center
notes: 📌 NEW: your own matchup is pinned at the very top of Standings, so you don't have to find it. Your team is always listed first.
👤 Tap any player's name in a lineup to open their player card.
🧮 Tap a player's points to see how they scored them, like 9 receptions for +9 and 145 receiving yards for +14.5. It updates live during the game.
⤢ Both work in the full-screen view too.
